findings.message: FakeClock has no sleep method or pending-deadline wakeup behavior. The moved Time exposes both, and Rig passes self.time.sleep to Watcher. Scope out explicitly requires a premise failure when a shared fake lacks needed behavior and forbids editing tests/fakes.py or introducing a duplicate clock.
findings.paved_road: Merge a prerequisite adding deadline-driven sleep and advance-triggered wakeups to FakeClock, then re-export it as Time in this ticket; alternatively explicitly authorize a clock adapter preserving that behavior.
